Provenance.drafts: Two rounds. Seed 714040's batch produced the best-composed gates in the set, and every one of them was uncuttable: the purple-stone arch sat on a purple backdrop, and the cutout either kept the whole frame (95% fill - the shipped-looking gate WAS its own backdrop, caught in a render, not in a measurement) or ate the building (35% fill at tolerance 20). Re-rolled as seed 714041 asking for a chroma backdrop the subject never contains; #4's dark teal field cuts cleanly at any tolerance from 30 to 90, which is the actual test of a good backdrop.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA at 0.9/0.9) diffuse, one ComfyUI KSampler pass at 896x1152, seed 714041, dpmpp_2m/karras, 30 steps, cfg 7.0, batch of 4. IPAdapter (vit-h, style transfer, weight 0.9) referenced market.png so palette and lighting lock to the Shop the owner named as art he likes -- the same chain this file recorded for the previous render, re-run rather than reinvented. Background removed by art/pipeline/gen-venues-r14.py's deterministic border-seeded flood fill against the border-median reference colour, then cropped to the alpha box, BOX-downsampled straight to the target height, and padded 1px of transparency on every side (VenueArtContractTests assertion 1). Sized to 121px = 3.56x the tallest resolved character body, ranked by role inside R14.8's 3.5-5.5x band rather than scaled uniformly: a uniform multiplier would have left the smaller buildings still undersized, which is the complaint (#142) still open. Replaces the render this file previously described, which measured 1.41-2.59x and is what made the heroes look too big for the town.
